method_note: Every file here is ACTIVE SUPPORT: pr_tests.yml:42 runs `python3 -m pytest` from the repository root, and pr_tests.yml:54 makes any change in the failure set a red check, so each module has a demonstrated consumer. The audit question for this directory is not whether the tests run - it is what they prove. Entries whose action cites F9 run green while proving only file existence, parser behaviour or config shape.
